architecture.mechanism: Raman spectroscopy characterization of soot to determine amorphous/graphitic carbon ratio and oxidation reactivity
architecture.intervention: Implement in-line Raman spectroscopy at the factory to analyze combustion byproducts from prototype engines, using the D/G intensity ratio to verify fuel-air mixture homogeneity and combustion completeness, thereby identifying manufacturing variances in fuel injectors or cylinder geometry that lead to localized overheating and connecting rod bearing failure.
architecture.expected_effect: Detection and correction of specific manufacturing defects causing incomplete combustion and excessive thermal load before mass production, resolving the root cause rather than masking symptoms with ECU updates.
architecture.falsification_test: Compare D/G intensity ratios from Raman spectra of soot samples collected from engines with known good bearings versus engines with documented bearing failures; if the ratios show no statistically significant difference correlating to the defect, the mechanism is falsified.

challenge.kill_reason: the mechanism-space distinctness adjudication counts 1 materially distinct mechanism(s) (< 2, mechanism_distinctness/2.0.0) — the run generated nothing worth attacking (Art. LXXXIV, R514)
